scope: Preserve the full verified runtime when recovering a stopped engineering sequence selection.
riskAnalysis: Recovery clones the complete already verified runtime rather than projecting legacy fields. Owner scope, two-read consistency, exact archive comparison, cleanup and backend authorization remain unchanged. No new authority, retries, policy or execution path.

threatModel.assets: Complete source/release identity and stopped-selection historical proof.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Authenticated recovery history to local non-authoritative selection cache.
threatModel.abuseCases: Drop contract marker, substitute runtime, clear active or foreign selection, treat cache as execution approval.
threatModel.mitigations: Clone all verified fields, retain all existing owner/history/cleanup checks and exact equality; backend fresh authorization remains mandatory.

defects.rootCause: Recovery reconstructed five runtime fields and omitted the later engineeringContract marker required by archival equality.
defects.detectionGap: Legacy recovery fixtures did not include the modern marker in complete stop/archive flow.
defects.regression: 150UIchecks pass including marked recovery/stop/archive, marker removal/substitution denials and legacy positive behavior.
defects.historicalPrevention: Copy full verified runtime rather than maintaining a second field list; full-marker lifecycle regression covers future omissions.

rollback: Restore the previously qualified feature Preview if final qualification fails; preserve all source/evidence history and never re-enable old approvals.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Unknown codes/raw errors remain hidden; malformed own records counted unverified.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact task/source/release checks unchanged; history is not execution authority.
negativePaths.concurrency: Existing CAS unchanged; same first consent remains idempotent and exact-bound.
negativePaths.cancellation: Connected fixture stops consent after run and asserts revoked grants/paidfalse.
negativePaths.api-outage: Unconfirmed delivery never retries automatically; exact intent retained for readback.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Foreign identities filtered before history validation; service actor gets no history.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No accounting policy changes; no paid inference in fixtures.
negativePaths.partial-execution: FinalChief preserves Auditor rejection; successfulworkflow is not proposalacceptance.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing recovery and archival controls only; no new broker or authority.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Native browser structuredClone already supported; VM harness exposes the same native primitive.
proactiveReview.threats: Local cached history must never replace exact backend approval or source checks.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Original live archive failed safely; existing server sequence was stopped and allgrantsrevoked.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Full marker preserved; missing/changed marker rejected and legacy unchanged behavior verified.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: WorkQA150checks and separate Auditor reviewed exact guards and complete runtime copy.
proactiveReview.recovery: Original selection history retained; one-line revert available; owner shutdown independently confirmed.
proactiveReview.readiness: 150focused checks plus exact-source independent reviews passed; hosted CI/Redis/CodeQL/Browser qualification required.
